title: `shouldResubmitMessages` throws if `messages` is mutated
body:
### Description

Calling `messages.pop()` when using `useChat` or any of the providers throws `TypeError: Cannot read property of undefined` when re-submitting the message.

### AI SDK Version

- ai: beta25

linked_prs.title: fix (ui): handle empty messages array in shouldResubmitMessages

## Background

This prevents #7473 when `messages` is an empty array, which can happen if the user mutates `messages` during `onError` or `onFinish` callbacks. Example use case: reverting last sent message when an error has occurred.

## Summary

<!-- What did you change? -->
Catch the condition early where `lastMessage` is undefined.

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This is an agent issue because it concerns memory content errors: mutating the `messages` array (which stores chat history) leads to a runtime failure during message resubmission, indicating flawed handling of agent memory state.
